on_failure_job:
name = "annual_orders_job"
description = "Build orders."
select = "orders"
schedule = { cron = "0 0 * * *", timezone = "UTC", starts_at = "2000-01-01T00:00:00Z" }
on_failure_sensor:
from sqlbuild.orchestration import NodeEventKind, node_event, sensor

failed_orders = sensor(
    'failed_orders_sensor',
    description='React to an actual orders check failure.',
    when=node_event(select='check:orders_valid', kinds=[NodeEventKind.FAILED]),
    run='refresh_inventory_job',
    minimum_interval_seconds=1,
)
inventory:
MODEL (description 'Inventory after check failure.', materialized table);
SELECT 59 AS amount;
